feeds.title: insura.ae Blog
feeds.description: Insura.ae is the insurance broker company that's got you covered. They are a leading insurance broker company based in the UAE since 1990. They provide a comprehensive range of insurance products and services to individuals, families, and businesses. Their mission is to help their clients protect themselves and their assets from risks while providing them peace of mind and financial security.

feeds.title: Orient Insurance
feeds.description: Orient Insurance Company is a customer-oriented insurer with over 40 years of experience in the UAE insurance market. The Company fully understands the customers' needs and is geared to provide innovative risk solutions to their entire satisfaction. The Company's core strengths lie in its strong financial base, highly qualified and customer-friendly workforce, in-depth knowledge of the local insurance market, and a diversified product range complimented by a strong panel of top-ranking European Reinsurers. Tap into their blog and learn more about the UAE Insurance Sector.

feeds.title: Al Wathba National Insurance Co Blog
feeds.description: From the very beginning, Al Wathba National Insurance Company has centered its business around people. It has constantly innovated solutions to help manage risk in ways that meet the needs of the customer and the market. Their commitment to being a one-stop shop for their customers means you can find every insurance product you might need in one convenient location.

feeds.title: UniTrust Insurance Blog
feeds.description: Unitrust Insurance Brokers is a duly licensed professional insurance broker established to operate in UAE to provide specialized and proficient insurance consultancy services to its valuable clients. Visit their blog section to find valuable insights and news from the insurance world.

feeds.title: Life Insurance Bazaar Blog
feeds.description: Life Insurance Bazaar is helping you secure your future financially through proper financial planning. Wade through their blog and learn more about personal, business, and commercial insurance, and financial planning.

feeds.title: InsuranceMarket.ae Blog
feeds.description: Alfred's InsuranceMarket.ae is the brainchild of AFIA Insurance Brokerage Services L.L.C. AFIA Insurance Brokerage Services L.L.C is a market-leading insurance brokerage in the UAE, licensed and regulated by the UAE Insurance Authority, and a HIIP holder under the Dubai Health Authority.

feeds.title: Pacific Prime Dubai Blog
feeds.description: Pacific Prime Dubai is a global insurance advisor that aims to provide individuals, families, and businesses of all sizes in Dubai with a quality health or medical insurance plan while also offering unbiased, reliable advice. Drawing upon over 21 years of experience, they are adept at developing innovative health insurance solutions tailored for each of their clients.

feeds.title: AllInsurance
feeds.description: Allinsurance simplifies the insurance comparison process, by ensuring that you have the knowledge and confidence to choose the right policies for your specific needs. Read their newest blog articles to learn more about the Insurance landscape and what steps you can take to safeguard your wealth and life.

feeds.title: Premium Insurance
feeds.description: Premium is a unique benchmark publication - it's the only monthly English-language magazine dedicated to the insurance sector. It gives state-of-the-art analysis of this vibrant industry, with in-depth reports and surveys, interviews with frontrunners of the industry and market-makers, and the latest insurance news to keep you at the forefront of developments. It sets a high standard, positioned as the pre-eminent publication in the sector, with editorial and production standards that are second to none.

feeds.title: InsuranceHub Blogs
feeds.description: Insurance Hub is an insurance comparison website in the UAE. They are dedicated to serving you with all the information that you need regarding insurance. They provide you with the information, expertise, and know-how and give you completely unbiased opinions and suggestions. Their mission is to provide holistic information for your insurance needs, like Car Insurance, Home Insurance, Health Insurance, and Life Insurance along with the top investment schemes in UAE, to enable you to compare different plans in one place and make informed purchase decisions.

feeds.title: Nexus Insurance Brokers Blog
feeds.description: Nexus group of companies offering a composite suite of insurance, savings, and investment products to both corporate and individual clients from a range of international and domestic product providers. Each member of their group is appropriately regulated by the relevant regulator for the provision of life insurance, savings plans, employee benefits, general insurance, and various classes of commercial insurance.
